title: Never-show list
description: The never-show list at profile paths.never_show (scripts/CONTRACTS.md 6.1b), one JSON file shared with /execution: /execution's banned-phrase grep reads entries of scope repo or both before every commit and before the public flip; /frontend's coverage.nevershow reads entries of scope rendered or both on rendered text. An entry whose until_utc is in the past is inactive. An embargo always carries its end date.

pattern.description: A literal substring, or a JavaScript regular expression when regex is true.

until_utc.description: UTC end of the entry; null means it never expires.

source.description: The file (and line when known) the entry comes from, for example a memory note or a redaction file.

allOf.description: An embargo has an end date.
